starting_spirits.description: Exceptional powers support executive control while censorship and repression corrode consent and intellectual freedom.

starting_spirits.title: Credit-Fuelled Miracle
starting_spirits.description: Public credit and investment sustain rapid industrial expansion while increasing exposure to financing costs.
starting_spirits.remedy: Development Loans or Export Discipline replaces the mixed starting credit settlement.

starting_spirits.title: Wage Compression
starting_spirits.description: Wage restraint protects industrial margins while concentrating the gains from growth.
starting_spirits.remedy: A wage settlement or free collective bargaining removes both sides of this starting policy.

starting_spirits.title: Uneven Technical Education
starting_spirits.description: Advanced industrial centres coexist with restricted access to schooling and specialist training.
starting_spirits.remedy: National Training or the PDT Mass Education programme.

starting_spirits.title: Land and Regional Inequality
starting_spirits.description: Concentrated landholding and uneven services make rural development politically difficult.
starting_spirits.remedy: Rural Settlement, Regional Extension or the PCdoB Agrarian Settlement.

starting_spirits.title: Cities Beyond Their Services
starting_spirits.description: Rapid urbanisation strains housing, public health, transport and municipal administration.
starting_spirits.remedy: Municipal Networks and Urban Services complete a joint remedy.

starting_spirits.title: Imported Energy Dependence
starting_spirits.description: Industrial expansion depends on imported oil. The later oil shocks have not yet happened.
starting_spirits.remedy: Offshore Supply or a diversified energy settlement removes this exposure.

starting_spirits.title: A Contested Frontier
starting_spirits.description: Roads, settlement and resource ambitions confront weak administration, indigenous rights and ecological limits.
starting_spirits.remedy: Frontier Safeguards or a funded Territorial Administration replaces the initial burden.
